research_questions.title: Primary operational effectiveness
research_questions.question: How do narrative model, controlled evidence condition, and their interaction affect end-to-end operational faithfulness across all planned LLM generations?
research_questions.unit_of_inference: canonical case with repeated model and evidence conditions
interpretation_restrictions: Do not treat claims as independent observations
Do not assume S0-S5 is a linear ordinal scale

research_questions.title: Conditional quality and structured missingness
research_questions.question: Among usable generations, how do semantic faithfulness and verifiability differ across models and evidence conditions, and are conclusions robust to structured S4 failures?
research_questions.population: 638 usable generations with 27 complete canonical cases for balanced sensitivity
interpretation_restrictions: Never impute conditional scores for unusable generations
Missingness is structured pipeline failure, not MCAR

research_questions.title: Evidence utilization and mechanisms
research_questions.question: Which evidence-exposure, narrative-policy, and claim-level mechanisms explain variation in operational faithfulness across models, evidence conditions, and case strata?
research_questions.population: 648 LLM generations, 216 evidence packages, 2941 evidence items, and 14667 validated claims
research_questions.unit_of_inference: descriptive generation, evidence package, claim, or canonical case as explicitly labeled
interpretation_restrictions: Safe-phrase overlap is a lexical signal, not proof of copying
Mechanism analyses are explanatory associations, not causal effects

research_questions.title: Deployment trade-offs
research_questions.question: What quality, reliability, and efficiency trade-offs distinguish the 18 LLM model-evidence options, and which options are preferred under explicit deployment priorities?
research_questions.population: 18 LLM model-evidence options across five frozen decision scenarios
interpretation_restrictions: Utility is a preference-based score, not probability or significance
What-if outputs are user-specified scenarios, not certified findings

research_questions.title: Measurement robustness
research_questions.question: How sensitive are the principal findings to the selected claim-measurement artifact release?
interpretation_restrictions: Do not claim V4 is more correct without human calibration
Artifact dependence must be reported as a material limitation

research_questions.title: Deterministic Template Baseline extension
research_questions.question: Compared with a deterministic non-LLM template under the same controlled evidence, what incremental informational value do LLM narratives provide, and what reliability and structural-efficiency costs accompany that value?
research_questions.population: 216 Template Baseline generations paired with 648 LLM generations
interpretation_restrictions: Template Baseline is not a fourth LLM and is excluded from decision ranking
Structured template claim extraction is deterministic but not identical to the LLM extraction channel
Naturalness, usefulness, and trust require human evaluation
Template latency at zero milliseconds is measurement-floor limited
